name: ggml-speech
description: Speech-stack ggml flavour (tetherto/qvac-ext-ggml@speech). This pin closes the Metal CPY hole from the k-quants to F32/F16 and makes Metal im2col dispatch-efficient on 1-D audio convolutions (PR #51). kernel_cpy_q_f32 was already generic over (T4x4, block_q, nl, dequantize_func) and ggml_metal_op_cpy already walked a quantised source in 16-element groups -- exactly the k-quant sub-block size -- so only the instantiations and the supports_op cases were missing, and ggml_cast(Q4_K -> F32) aborted with "unsupported op 'CPY'". That is reachable today rather than hypothetical: the ACE-Step FSQ detokenizer keeps detokenizer.special_tokens verbatim, so q3_as_f32 lowers to a cast from the DiT quant, and the addon's default variant is acestep-v15-turbo-Q4_K_M; Vulkan hit the identical hole and was fixed in PR #47, while Metal kept it only because the stage was pinned to the CPU there. q2_K/q3_K/q4_K/q5_K/q6_K are added in the dequantise direction only, matching Vulkan and the CPU backend. test-backend-ops -o CPY -b MTL0 goes from "not supported" to 6/6 on the k-quant cases, 101/101 whole-op, and the full ACE-Step pipeline now runs end to end on Metal with the turbo-q4 model set (detokenizer latents CPU vs Metal cosine 0.99995005). Separately, kernel_im2col put (N, KH, KW) in the threadgroup: with KH == 1 and N == 1, as every 1-D audio convolution is, that left KW threads -- 7, or 1 for a pointwise conv -- against a 32-wide SIMD group, so an im2col of [896 x 675840] and one of [128 x 675840] both cost ~170 ms, i.e. the op was bound by threadgroup dispatch rather than bandwidth. Each output position now gets one threadgroup whose threads walk that position's contiguous CHW columns, so writes coalesce and the threadgroup is sized from CHW padded to a SIMD width. im2col is a pure gather, so this is bit-exact -- the ACE-Step VAE renders a byte-identical wav -- at VAE decode 7980 -> 3043 ms (2.62x) and full pipeline 15383 -> 10043 ms on an Apple M5, with IM2COL 88/88, CONV_2D 1568/1568 and CONV_TRANSPOSE_1D 116/116 on MTL0. Carries the unaligned-M Adreno OpenCL im2col fusion (PR #50), the Adreno OpenCL Parler-TTS fixes (PR #49), Vulkan CPY from the k-quants to F32 (PR #47), the GGML_PREC_F32 work on Vulkan and Metal (PR #46) and the Vulkan ACE-Step Oobleck VAE custom ops (PR #45). CPU output is unchanged.

metal-fuse-mv-bias.description: Compile in the Q-variant mul_mv + ADD(bias) [+ ADD(residual)] fusion in ggml-metal. Off by default: empirically produces zero tokens on parakeet's EOU q8_0 joint network. Opt in only after Metal A/B-validating your model against the fused path.
